This Function Block governs the safety-critical propellant loading and chilldown sequence for a sub-orbital
reusable launch vehicle operating with either Liquid Oxygen (LOX, 90.19 K) or Liquid Methane (LCH4, 111.66 K).
The algorithm integrates four advanced cyber-physical control and state-estimation domains:

1. TWO-PHASE FILM-TO-NUCLEATE BOILING HEAT TRANSFER STATE ESTIMATION:
   Cryogenic transfer line chilldown undergoes extreme thermal non-equilibrium. As warm ground transfer piping
   (ambient T_init ~ 295 K) is exposed to liquid cryogen, heat flux spans five distinct Nukiyama boiling regimes:
   
   a) Stable Film Boiling (Leidenfrost Regime):
      When wall superheat Delta_T_sat = (T_wall - T_sat) > Delta_T_Leidenfrost (~42.5 K for LOX, ~52.0 K for CH4),
      an insulating vapor cushion forms against the pipe wall. Heat transfer is governed by the modified
      Bromley-Nukiyama correlation:
          h_film = 0.62 * [ (k_v^3 * rho_v * (rho_l - rho_v) * g * (h_lv + 0.4 * c_pv * Delta_T_sat)) /
                            (D_inner * mu_v * Delta_T_sat) ]^(1/4)
      Vapor generation is massive, leading to choked two-phase flow and vapor lock if unmitigated.
      
   b) Transition Boiling (Quench Front Collapse):
      Occurs in the unstable negative-differential heat flux zone (Delta_T_MHF < Delta_T_sat < Delta_T_CHF).
      Intermittent liquid-wall contact produces high-amplitude thermo-acoustic shock waves. The quench
      front propagation velocity is tracked via a discrete Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) state-space model.
      
   c) Nucleate Boiling (Peak Critical Heat Flux - CHF):
      Governed by the Rohsenow boiling correlation:
          q_dot_nucleate = mu_l * h_lv * sqrt(g * (rho_l - rho_v) / sigma) *
                           [ (c_pl * Delta_T_sat) / (C_sf * h_lv * Pr_l^1.7) ]^3
      Heat flux reaches peak values exceeding 1.2 MW/m2, driving rapid wall temperature collapse.
      
   d) Single-Phase Subcooled Convection:
      When T_wall < T_sat, vapor generation ceases. Flow transitions to 100% single-phase liquid governed by
      the Dittus-Boelter correlation: Nu = 0.023 * Re^0.8 * Pr^0.4.

2. TRANSIENT WATER-HAMMER AND HYDRO-ELASTIC SURGE SUPPRESSION:
   Sudden phase collapse or rapid valve throttling in cryogenic lines induces extreme Joukowsky pressure surges:
       Delta_P_surge = rho_mix * a_mix * Delta_v
   Crucially, in two-phase cryogenic flow, acoustic wave speed a_mix is highly non-linear and collapses drastically
   due to the high compressibility of entrained vapor bubbles:
       a_mix = 1.0 / sqrt( rho_mix * ( (alpha / (rho_v * a_v^2)) + ((1.0 - alpha) / (rho_l * a_l^2)) ) )
   Even 0.1% vapor void fraction collapses wave speed from ~1000 m/s to ~120 m/s, followed by catastrophic wave

   where speed of sound in ullage gas is:

    rValveCmd_MainCryoSupply := 0.0;

(* SUB-SECTION 2.0: TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3) SENSOR VOTING AND FAULT DIAGNOSTICS ENGINE     *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* The Mid-Value Selection (MVS) algorithm processes three channels (A, B, C) for each critical    *)
(* physical parameter. It checks for sensor drift, out-of-bounds discrepancies, and channel failure. *)
(* Graceful degradation cascades: 2oo3 (3 healthy) -> 1oo2 (1 failed) -> 1oo1 (2 failed) -> Trip.  *)

(* === 2.1: Ground Transfer Line Pressure Voting (PT_A, PT_B, PT_C) === *)
bDegraded_LinePressure_ChA := (ABS(rPressure_Line_Transmitter_A - rPressure_Line_Transmitter_B) > 1.5) AND
                              (ABS(rPressure_Line_Transmitter_A - rPressure_Line_Transmitter_C) > 1.5);
bDegraded_LinePressure_ChB := (ABS(rPressure_Line_Transmitter_B - rPressure_Line_Transmitter_A) > 1.5) AND
                              (ABS(rPressure_Line_Transmitter_B - rPressure_Line_Transmitter_C) > 1.5);
bDegraded_LinePressure_ChC := (ABS(rPressure_Line_Transmitter_C - rPressure_Line_Transmitter_A) > 1.5) AND
                              (ABS(rPressure_Line_Transmitter_C - rPressure_Line_Transmitter_B) > 1.5);

IF (NOT bDegraded_LinePressure_ChA) AND (NOT bDegraded_LinePressure_ChB) AND (NOT bDegraded_LinePressure_ChC) THEN
    (* All 3 channels healthy: Mid-Value Selection (Median) *)
    IF (rPressure_Line_Transmitter_A >= rPressure_Line_Transmitter_B AND rPressure_Line_Transmitter_A <= rPressure_Line_Transmitter_C) OR
       (rPressure_Line_Transmitter_A <= rPressure_Line_Transmitter_B AND rPressure_Line_Transmitter_A >= rPressure_Line_Transmitter_C) THEN
        rVoted_LinePressure := rPressure_Line_Transmitter_A;
    ELSIF (rPressure_Line_Transmitter_B >= rPressure_Line_Transmitter_A AND rPressure_Line_Transmitter_B <= rPressure_Line_Transmitter_C) OR
          (rPressure_Line_Transmitter_B <= rPressure_Line_Transmitter_A AND rPressure_Line_Transmitter_B >= rPressure_Line_Transmitter_C) THEN
        rVoted_LinePressure := rPressure_Line_Transmitter_B;
    ELSE
        rVoted_LinePressure := rPressure_Line_Transmitter_C;
    END_IF;
ELSIF bDegraded_LinePressure_ChA AND (NOT bDegraded_LinePressure_ChB) AND (NOT bDegraded_LinePressure_ChC) THEN
    (* Channel A Failed: Degraded 1oo2 Average of B and C *)
    rVoted_LinePressure := (rPressure_Line_Transmitter_B + rPressure_Line_Transmitter_C) * 0.5;
    dwSensorDegradedStatus := dwSensorDegradedStatus OR 16#00000001;
ELSIF bDegraded_LinePressure_ChB AND (NOT bDegraded_LinePressure_ChA) AND (NOT bDegraded_LinePressure_ChC) THEN
    (* Channel B Failed: Degraded 1oo2 Average of A and C *)
    rVoted_LinePressure := (rPressure_Line_Transmitter_A + rPressure_Line_Transmitter_C) * 0.5;
    dwSensorDegradedStatus := dwSensorDegradedStatus OR 16#00000002;
ELSIF bDegraded_LinePressure_ChC AND (NOT bDegraded_LinePressure_ChA) AND (NOT bDegraded_LinePressure_ChB) THEN
    (* Channel C Failed: Degraded 1oo2 Average of A and B *)
    rVoted_LinePressure := (rPressure_Line_Transmitter_A + rPressure_Line_Transmitter_B) * 0.5;
    dwSensorDegradedStatus := dwSensorDegradedStatus OR 16#00000004;
ELSE
    (* Multiple sensor failure: Degrade to valid channel or trigger abort trip *)
    rVoted_LinePressure := rPressure_Line_Transmitter_A;
    dwSensorDegradedStatus := dwSensorDegradedStatus OR 16#00000008;
    dwAlarmTripWord_Warning := dwAlarmTripWord_Warning OR 16#00000001;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* SUB-SECTION 3.0: CRYOGENIC THERMOPHYSICAL PROPERTY ENGINE (LOX vs LCH4 EVALUATION)               *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Selects state equations depending on bPropellantSelect_LOX selector flag.                        *)
(* Calculates saturation temperature T_sat(P), liquid/vapor densities, latent heat, and acoustic  *)
(* velocities based on high-accuracy Peng-Robinson / NIST REFPROP polynomial regressions.          *)

IF bPropellantSelect_LOX THEN
    (* ============================================================================================ *)
    (* LIQUID OXYGEN (LOX) THERMOPHYSICAL EQUATIONS (Normal Boiling Point: 90.19 K @ 1.013 bar)     *)
    (* ============================================================================================ *)
    (* Antoine Saturation Curve: log10(P_bar) = A - B / (T + C) -> T_sat = B / (A - log10(P)) - C   *)
    (* Valid range: 75 K to 145 K                                                                   *)
    IF rVoted_LinePressure > 0.05 THEN
        rProp_SatTemp := 90.19 + (rVoted_LinePressure - 1.013) * 6.85 - ((rVoted_LinePressure - 1.013) * (rVoted_LinePressure - 1.013)) * 0.35;
    ELSE
        rProp_SatTemp := 90.19;
    END_IF;

    (* Saturated Liquid Density: rho_l [kg/m3] (Rackett polynomial fit) *)
    rProp_Density_Liquid := 1141.2 - 3.82 * (rVoted_FluidTemperature - 90.19);
    IF rProp_Density_Liquid < 950.0 THEN
        rProp_Density_Liquid := 950.0;
    END_IF;

    (* Saturated Vapor Density: rho_v [kg/m3] via Ideal Gas Law with compressibility factor Z ~ 0.94 *)
    rProp_Density_Vapor := (rVoted_LinePressure * 100000.0 * 0.032) / (0.94 * 8.31446 * rProp_SatTemp);
    IF rProp_Density_Vapor < 1.0 THEN
        rProp_Density_Vapor := 1.0;
    END_IF;

    (* Latent Heat of Vaporization: h_lv [J/kg] *)
    rProp_LatentHeat_Hlv := 213000.0 - 450.0 * (rVoted_FluidTemperature - 90.19);

    (* Specific Heat Capacities [J/(kg*K)] *)
    rProp_SpecificHeat_Cp_Liquid := 1698.0 + 3.2 * (rVoted_FluidTemperature - 90.19);
    rProp_SpecificHeat_Cp_Vapor := 918.0 + 1.1 * (rVoted_FluidTemperature - 90.19);

    (* Dynamic Viscosities [Pa*s] *)
    rProp_DynamicViscosity_Liquid := 0.000192; (* 192 uPa*s @ 90 K *)
    rProp_DynamicViscosity_Vapor := 0.0000072; (* 7.2 uPa*s @ 90 K *)

    (* Surface Tension [N/m] *)
    rProp_SurfaceTension_Sigma := 0.0132 - 0.00021 * (rVoted_FluidTemperature - 90.19);
    IF rProp_SurfaceTension_Sigma < 0.002 THEN
        rProp_SurfaceTension_Sigma := 0.002;
    END_IF;

    (* Thermal Conductivity of Vapor [W/(m*K)] *)
    rProp_ThermalConductivity_Vapor := 0.0089;

    (* Speeds of Sound [m/s] *)
    rProp_SpeedOfSound_Liquid := 912.0 - 5.1 * (rVoted_FluidTemperature - 90.19);
    rProp_SpeedOfSound_Vapor := 182.0 + 0.85 * (rVoted_FluidTemperature - 90.19);

    (* Zuber Critical Heat Flux (CHF) [W/m2]: q''_CHF = 0.131 * rho_v^0.5 * h_lv * (g * sigma * (rho_l - rho_v))^0.25 *)
    rProp_CriticalHeatFlux_Zuber := 0.131 * SQRT(rProp_Density_Vapor) * rProp_LatentHeat_Hlv *
                                    SQRT(SQRT(9.80665 * rProp_SurfaceTension_Sigma * (rProp_Density_Liquid - rProp_Density_Vapor)));

    (* Minimum Leidenfrost Temperature Superheat [K] *)
    rProp_Leidenfrost_DeltaT := 42.5;

    (* Ullage Gas Molecular Weight and Adiabatic Index (LOX Vapor + GHe Purge) *)
    rUllageMolarMass_kg_mol := 0.0245; (* Blended molar mass [kg/mol] *)
    rUllageSpecificHeatRatio_Gamma := 1.48;

ELSE
    (* ============================================================================================ *)
    (* LIQUID METHANE (LCH4) THERMOPHYSICAL EQUATIONS (Normal Boiling Point: 111.66 K @ 1.013 bar)  *)
    (* ============================================================================================ *)
    IF rVoted_LinePressure > 0.05 THEN
        rProp_SatTemp := 111.66 + (rVoted_LinePressure - 1.013) * 8.95 - ((rVoted_LinePressure - 1.013) * (rVoted_LinePressure - 1.013)) * 0.42;
    ELSE
        rProp_SatTemp := 111.66;
    END_IF;

    (* Saturated Liquid Density: rho_l [kg/m3] *)
    rProp_Density_Liquid := 422.6 - 1.45 * (rVoted_FluidTemperature - 111.66);
    IF rProp_Density_Liquid < 350.0 THEN
        rProp_Density_Liquid := 350.0;
    END_IF;

    (* Saturated Vapor Density: rho_v [kg/m3] (Methane Mw = 16.04 g/mol) *)
    rProp_Density_Vapor := (rVoted_LinePressure * 100000.0 * 0.01604) / (0.96 * 8.31446 * rProp_SatTemp);
    IF rProp_Density_Vapor < 0.5 THEN
        rProp_Density_Vapor := 0.5;
    END_IF;

    (* Latent Heat of Vaporization: h_lv [J/kg] *)
    rProp_LatentHeat_Hlv := 510000.0 - 920.0 * (rVoted_FluidTemperature - 111.66);

    (* Specific Heat Capacities [J/(kg*K)] *)
    rProp_SpecificHeat_Cp_Liquid := 3480.0 + 5.5 * (rVoted_FluidTemperature - 111.66);
    rProp_SpecificHeat_Cp_Vapor := 1950.0 + 2.8 * (rVoted_FluidTemperature - 111.66);

    (* Dynamic Viscosities [Pa*s] *)
    rProp_DynamicViscosity_Liquid := 0.000115; (* 115 uPa*s @ 112 K *)
    rProp_DynamicViscosity_Vapor := 0.0000054; (* 5.4 uPa*s @ 112 K *)

    (* Surface Tension [N/m] *)
    rProp_SurfaceTension_Sigma := 0.0158 - 0.00028 * (rVoted_FluidTemperature - 111.66);
    IF rProp_SurfaceTension_Sigma < 0.002 THEN
        rProp_SurfaceTension_Sigma := 0.002;
    END_IF;

    (* Thermal Conductivity of Vapor [W/(m*K)] *)
    rProp_ThermalConductivity_Vapor := 0.0125;

    (* Speeds of Sound [m/s] *)
    rProp_SpeedOfSound_Liquid := 1330.0 - 8.2 * (rVoted_FluidTemperature - 111.66);
    rProp_SpeedOfSound_Vapor := 275.0 + 1.2 * (rVoted_FluidTemperature - 111.66);

    (* Zuber Critical Heat Flux [W/m2] *)
    rProp_CriticalHeatFlux_Zuber := 0.131 * SQRT(rProp_Density_Vapor) * rProp_LatentHeat_Hlv *
                                    SQRT(SQRT(9.80665 * rProp_SurfaceTension_Sigma * (rProp_Density_Liquid - rProp_Density_Vapor)));

    (* Minimum Leidenfrost Temperature Superheat [K] *)
    rProp_Leidenfrost_DeltaT := 52.0;

    (* Ullage Gas Molecular Weight and Adiabatic Index (CH4 Vapor + GHe Purge) *)
    rUllageMolarMass_kg_mol := 0.0128;
    rUllageSpecificHeatRatio_Gamma := 1.38;
END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* SUB-SECTION 4.0: EXTENDED STATE ESTIMATOR & BOILING REGIME IDENTIFICATION                         *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Propagates discrete 4x4 thermal conduction and two-phase expansion state equations:              *)
(*   X_prior(k) = A_d * X(k-1) + B_d * U(k-1)                                                      *)
(*   Y_meas(k) = [rVoted_WallTemperature, rVoted_FluidTemperature]^T                              *)
(*   X_est(k) = X_prior(k) + K_k * (Y_meas(k) - C_d * X_prior(k))                                 *)
(* Identifies active boiling regime: Film Boiling, Transition Boiling, Nucleate Boiling, Subcooled. *)

(* === 4.1: Compute Prior State Prediction X_prior === *)
aState_X_Prior[1] := aMatrix_A[1,1]*aState_X[1] + aMatrix_A[1,2]*aState_X[2] + aMatrix_A[1,3]*aState_X[3] + aMatrix_A[1,4]*aState_X[4] +
                     aMatrix_B[1,1]*rVoted_MassFlow + aMatrix_B[1,2]*250.0; (* 250 W ambient heat leak *)
aState_X_Prior[2] := aMatrix_A[2,1]*aState_X[1] + aMatrix_A[2,2]*aState_X[2] + aMatrix_A[2,3]*aState_X[3] + aMatrix_A[2,4]*aState_X[4] +
                     aMatrix_B[2,1]*rVoted_MassFlow + aMatrix_B[2,2]*250.0;
aState_X_Prior[3] := aMatrix_A[3,1]*aState_X[1] + aMatrix_A[3,2]*aState_X[2] + aMatrix_A[3,3]*aState_X[3] + aMatrix_A[3,4]*aState_X[4] +
                     aMatrix_B[3,1]*rVoted_MassFlow + aMatrix_B[3,2]*250.0;
aState_X_Prior[4] := aMatrix_A[4,1]*aState_X[1] + aMatrix_A[4,2]*aState_X[2] + aMatrix_A[4,3]*aState_X[3] + aMatrix_A[4,4]*aState_X[4] +
                     aMatrix_B[4,1]*rVoted_MassFlow + aMatrix_B[4,2]*250.0;

(* Clamp predicted void fraction alpha between 0.0 and 1.0 *)
IF aState_X_Prior[4] > 1.0 THEN
    aState_X_Prior[4] := 1.0;
ELSIF aState_X_Prior[4] < 0.0 THEN
    aState_X_Prior[4] := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* === 4.2: Compute Observation Prediction and Innovation Residuals === *)
aState_Y_Pred[1] := aMatrix_C[1,1]*aState_X_Prior[1] + aMatrix_C[1,2]*aState_X_Prior[2] + aMatrix_C[1,3]*aState_X_Prior[3] + aMatrix_C[1,4]*aState_X_Prior[4];
aState_Y_Pred[2] := aMatrix_C[2,1]*aState_X_Prior[1] + aMatrix_C[2,2]*aState_X_Prior[2] + aMatrix_C[2,3]*aState_X_Prior[3] + aMatrix_C[2,4]*aState_X_Prior[4];

aState_Y_Meas[1] := rVoted_WallTemperature;
aState_Y_Meas[2] := rVoted_FluidTemperature;

(* Innovation vector: Y_err = Y_meas - Y_pred *)
(* Update Posterior State Vector X = X_prior + K * Y_err *)
aState_X[1] := aState_X_Prior[1] + aKalmanGain[1,1]*(aState_Y_Meas[1] - aState_Y_Pred[1]) + aKalmanGain[1,2]*(aState_Y_Meas[2] - aState_Y_Pred[2]);
aState_X[2] := aState_X_Prior[2] + aKalmanGain[2,1]*(aState_Y_Meas[1] - aState_Y_Pred[1]) + aKalmanGain[2,2]*(aState_Y_Meas[2] - aState_Y_Pred[2]);
aState_X[3] := aState_X_Prior[3] + aKalmanGain[3,1]*(aState_Y_Meas[1] - aState_Y_Pred[1]) + aKalmanGain[3,2]*(aState_Y_Meas[2] - aState_Y_Pred[2]);
aState_X[4] := aState_X_Prior[4] + aKalmanGain[4,1]*(aState_Y_Meas[1] - aState_Y_Pred[1]) + aKalmanGain[4,2]*(aState_Y_Meas[2] - aState_Y_Pred[2]);

IF aState_X[4] > 1.0 THEN
    aState_X[4] := 1.0;
ELSIF aState_X[4] < 0.0 THEN
    aState_X[4] := 0.0;
END_IF;

rLineVaporQuality := aState_X[4]; (* Void fraction maps directly to vapor quality *)

(* === 4.3: Calculate Wall Heat Flux and Boiling Heat Transfer Coefficient === *)
(* Delta_T_superheat = T_wall_inner - T_sat *)
IF aState_X[1] > rProp_SatTemp THEN
    (* Wall is superheated: Determine active boiling regime on Nukiyama curve *)
    IF (aState_X[1] - rProp_SatTemp) >= rProp_Leidenfrost_DeltaT THEN
        (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* REGIME 4: STABLE FILM BOILING (LEIDENFROST REGIME)                                      *)
        (* Bromley Modified Correlation: Low heat transfer coefficient, thick vapor barrier film.   *)
        (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        dwBoilingRegimeStatus := 16#00000004;
        bLeidenfrostQuenchDetected := FALSE;
        rTransferLineHeatTransferCoeff := 0.62 * SQRT(SQRT(
            (rProp_ThermalConductivity_Vapor * rProp_ThermalConductivity_Vapor * rProp_ThermalConductivity_Vapor *
             rProp_Density_Vapor * (rProp_Density_Liquid - rProp_Density_Vapor) * 9.80665 *
             (rProp_LatentHeat_Hlv + 0.4 * rProp_SpecificHeat_Cp_Vapor * (aState_X[1] - rProp_SatTemp))) /
            (rPipeInnerDiameter_m * rProp_DynamicViscosity_Vapor * (aState_X[1] - rProp_SatTemp + 0.001))
        ));
        IF rTransferLineHeatTransferCoeff < 120.0 THEN
            rTransferLineHeatTransferCoeff := 120.0;
        END_IF;

    ELSIF (aState_X[1] - rProp_SatTemp) > 18.0 AND (aState_X[1] - rProp_SatTemp) < rProp_Leidenfrost_DeltaT THEN
        (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* REGIME 3: TRANSITION BOILING (QUENCH FRONT DESTABILIZATION)                             *)
        (* Vapor film collapses intermittently. Sharp rise in heat flux and acoustic emissions.     *)
        (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        dwBoilingRegimeStatus := 16#00000003;
        bLeidenfrostQuenchDetected := TRUE;
        (* Interpolated heat transfer coefficient between Leidenfrost and Nucleate peak *)
        rTransferLineHeatTransferCoeff := 850.0 + (rProp_Leidenfrost_DeltaT - (aState_X[1] - rProp_SatTemp)) * 145.0;

    ELSIF (aState_X[1] - rProp_SatTemp) >= 2.0 AND (aState_X[1] - rProp_SatTemp) <= 18.0 THEN
        (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* REGIME 2: NUCLEATE BOILING (ROHSENOW CORRELATION)                                       *)
        (* High-efficiency micro-bubble detachment. Extremely high heat flux up to CHF.            *)
        (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        dwBoilingRegimeStatus := 16#00000002;
        bLeidenfrostQuenchDetected := TRUE;
        rTransferLineHeatTransferCoeff := 4500.0 + (aState_X[1] - rProp_SatTemp) * 620.0;
        IF rTransferLineHeatTransferCoeff > 14000.0 THEN
            rTransferLineHeatTransferCoeff := 14000.0;
        END_IF;

    ELSE
        (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* REGIME 1: ONSET OF NUCLEATE BOILING (ONB) / NATURAL CONVECTION                           *)
        (* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        dwBoilingRegimeStatus := 16#00000001;
        rTransferLineHeatTransferCoeff := 650.0;
    END_IF;

    rEstimatedLineHeatFlux := (rTransferLineHeatTransferCoeff * (aState_X[1] - rProp_SatTemp)) / 1000.0; (* kW/m2 *)
ELSE
    (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    (* REGIME 0: SUBCOOLED SINGLE-PHASE LIQUID CONVECTION                                          *)
    (* Wall temperature has quenched below saturation. Transfer line is primed with pure liquid.   *)
    (* Dittus-Boelter Correlation: Nu = 0.023 * Re^0.8 * Pr^0.4                                     *)
    (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    dwBoilingRegimeStatus := 16#00000000;
    rTransferLineHeatTransferCoeff := 2800.0;
    rEstimatedLineHeatFlux := (rTransferLineHeatTransferCoeff * (aState_X[1] - rProp_SatTemp)) / 1000.0; (* Negative or zero *)
END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* SUB-SECTION 5.0: TRANSIENT WATER-HAMMER JOUKOWSKY SURGE SUPPRESSION & HYDRO-ELASTIC PROTECTION   *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Cryogenic two-phase fluid acoustic wave velocity a_mix collapses drastically with vapor void     *)
(* fraction alpha. If downstream valves slam closed or rapid condensation occurs, Joukowsky surge   *)
(* Delta_P = rho_mix * a_mix * Delta_v can shatter vacuum-jacketed pipe and flight umbilicals.     *)

(* === 5.1: Two-Phase Mixture Density and Bulk Velocity === *)
rTwoPhaseMixtureDensity_kg_m3 := (aState_X[4] * rProp_Density_Vapor) + ((1.0 - aState_X[4]) * rProp_Density_Liquid);
IF rTwoPhaseMixtureDensity_kg_m3 < 5.0 THEN
    rTwoPhaseMixtureDensity_kg_m3 := 5.0;
END_IF;

(* Flow velocity in pipe: v = m_dot / (rho_mix * A_pipe) *)
rFluidVelocity_mps := rVoted_MassFlow / (rTwoPhaseMixtureDensity_kg_m3 * rPipeCrossSectionArea_m2);
IF rFluidVelocity_mps > 45.0 THEN
    rFluidVelocity_mps := 45.0; (* Cap numerical artifacts *)
ELSIF rFluidVelocity_mps < 0.0 THEN
    rFluidVelocity_mps := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* === 5.2: Hydro-Elastic Acoustic Wave Velocity a_mix === *)
(* Effective bulk modulus: 1 / K_mix = alpha / K_vapor + (1 - alpha) / K_liquid *)
(* In two-phase bubbly mixture, Wood's equation predicts severe sound speed minimum (~120 m/s @ alpha=0.1) *)
IF aState_X[4] > 0.005 AND aState_X[4] < 0.995 THEN
    (* Two-phase mixture sound speed *)
    rAcousticWaveSpeed_Mix_mps := 1.0 / SQRT(
        rTwoPhaseMixtureDensity_kg_m3 *
        ( (aState_X[4] / (rProp_Density_Vapor * rProp_SpeedOfSound_Vapor * rProp_SpeedOfSound_Vapor)) +
          ((1.0 - aState_X[4]) / (rProp_Density_Liquid * rProp_SpeedOfSound_Liquid * rProp_SpeedOfSound_Liquid)) )
    );
    (* Correction for pipe wall elasticity: c1 = 1.0 (thin-walled pipe anchored at skids) *)
    rAcousticWaveSpeed_Mix_mps := rAcousticWaveSpeed_Mix_mps / SQRT(
        1.0 + ((rTwoPhaseMixtureDensity_kg_m3 * rAcousticWaveSpeed_Mix_mps * rAcousticWaveSpeed_Mix_mps) / rPipeYoungsModulus_Pa) *
        (rPipeInnerDiameter_m / rPipeWallThickness_m)
    );
ELSIF aState_X[4] <= 0.005 THEN
    (* Subcooled pure liquid sound speed *)
    rAcousticWaveSpeed_Mix_mps := rProp_SpeedOfSound_Liquid / SQRT(
        1.0 + ((rProp_Density_Liquid * rProp_SpeedOfSound_Liquid * rProp_SpeedOfSound_Liquid) / rPipeYoungsModulus_Pa) *
        (rPipeInnerDiameter_m / rPipeWallThickness_m)
    );
ELSE
    (* Pure vapor sound speed *)
    rAcousticWaveSpeed_Mix_mps := rProp_SpeedOfSound_Vapor;
END_IF;

IF rAcousticWaveSpeed_Mix_mps < 85.0 THEN
    rAcousticWaveSpeed_Mix_mps := 85.0;
ELSIF rAcousticWaveSpeed_Mix_mps > 1400.0 THEN
    rAcousticWaveSpeed_Mix_mps := 1400.0;
END_IF;

(* Critical water hammer pipe closure period: t_crit = 2 * L / a *)
rCriticalValveClosureTime_s := (2.0 * rPipeLength_Total_m) / rAcousticWaveSpeed_Mix_mps;

(* Joukowsky potential instantaneous pressure spike: Delta_P = rho * a * Delta_v [converted to bar] *)
rJoukowskySurgePressure_bar := (rTwoPhaseMixtureDensity_kg_m3 * rAcousticWaveSpeed_Mix_mps * rFluidVelocity_mps) / 100000.0;

(* Surge safety margin before hitting pipe design limit (Design limit = 28.0 bar gauge) *)
rJoukowskySurgeMargin_bar := 28.0 - (rVoted_LinePressure + rJoukowskySurgePressure_bar);

(* Differentiate line pressure with 4-tap FIR digital noise filter *)
rFilterBuf_dP[4] := rFilterBuf_dP[3];
rFilterBuf_dP[3] := rFilterBuf_dP[2];
rFilterBuf_dP[2] := rFilterBuf_dP[1];
rFilterBuf_dP[1] := (rVoted_LinePressure - rPressure_Line_Previous) / rDeltaTime_Seconds;
rPressure_Line_Previous := rVoted_LinePressure;

rPressureRateOfChange_bar_per_s := 0.40 * rFilterBuf_dP[1] + 0.30 * rFilterBuf_dP[2] + 0.20 * rFilterBuf_dP[3] + 0.10 * rFilterBuf_dP[4];

(* === 5.3: Active Fast-Acting Surge Suppression Trigger Logic === *)
(* If transient pressure rise dP/dt > 12.5 bar/s OR Joukowsky surge margin drops below 3.0 bar,      *)
(* immediately pop the high-speed electro-pneumatic surge relief bypass valve for 350 ms.          *)
tSurgeReliefTimer(IN := bSurgeSuppressorEnable AND
                        ((rPressureRateOfChange_bar_per_s > 12.5) OR (rJoukowskySurgeMargin_bar < 3.0)),
                  PT := T#350MS);

IF tSurgeReliefTimer.IN AND (NOT tSurgeReliefTimer.Q) THEN
    rValveCmd_SurgeBypassFastActing := 100.0; (* Fast relief pop *)
    bWaterHammerSurgeAlarm := TRUE;
    dwAlarmTripWord_Warning := dwAlarmTripWord_Warning OR 16#00000004; (* Surge alarm flag *)
ELSE
    rValveCmd_SurgeBypassFastActing := 0.0;
    bWaterHammerSurgeAlarm := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* SUB-SECTION 6.0: ACOUSTIC RESONANCE PROPELLANT MASS LEVEL TELEMETRY & SENSOR FUSION               *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Flight tank propellant mass is measured continuously via non-intrusive acoustic cavity resonance.  *)
(* The ullage gas cavity vibrates at characteristic Helmholtz and longitudinal quarter-wave modes.  *)
(* Resonant frequency f_res increases monotonically as ullage volume shrinks during propellant fill.  *)

IF bAcousticTelemetryEnable THEN
    (* Speed of sound in warm ullage gas: c_ullage = sqrt( gamma * (R_u / M) * T_ullage ) *)
    (* Flight tank ullage gas is sampled at ~150 K average stratified boundary *)
    rUllageAcousticSpeedOfSound_mps := SQRT(
        rUllageSpecificHeatRatio_Gamma * (8314.46 / (rUllageMolarMass_kg_mol * 1000.0)) * 155.0
    );
    IF rUllageAcousticSpeedOfSound_mps < 180.0 THEN
        rUllageAcousticSpeedOfSound_mps := 180.0;
    ELSIF rUllageAcousticSpeedOfSound_mps > 450.0 THEN
        rUllageAcousticSpeedOfSound_mps := 450.0;
    END_IF;

    (* Invert Helmholtz Resonator Equation:                                                         *)
    (*   f_0 = (c / 2*PI) * sqrt( A_neck / (V_ullage * L_eff) )                                     *)
    (*   V_ullage = (A_neck * c^2) / (4 * PI^2 * f_0^2 * L_eff)                                     *)
    IF rVoted_AcousticPeakFreq > 12.0 AND rVoted_AcousticPeakFreq < 350.0 THEN
        rAcousticUllageVolume := (rAcousticResonator_NeckArea_m2 * rUllageAcousticSpeedOfSound_mps * rUllageAcousticSpeedOfSound_mps) /
                                 (39.4784 * rVoted_AcousticPeakFreq * rVoted_AcousticPeakFreq * rAcousticResonator_EffLength_m);

        (* Clamp ullage volume between 0.05 m3 and total internal tank volume *)
        IF rAcousticUllageVolume > rTankTotalInternalVolume THEN
            rAcousticUllageVolume := rTankTotalInternalVolume;
        ELSIF rAcousticUllageVolume < 0.05 THEN
            rAcousticUllageVolume := 0.05;
        END_IF;

        (* Compute Raw Acoustic Liquid Mass: M_prop = (V_tank - V_ullage) * rho_liquid *)
        rAcousticMassEstimate_Raw := (rTankTotalInternalVolume - rAcousticUllageVolume) * rProp_Density_Liquid;
        IF rAcousticMassEstimate_Raw < 0.0 THEN
            rAcousticMassEstimate_Raw := 0.0;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        (* Acoustic signal out of modal locking range: Maintain current estimate *)
        rAcousticMassEstimate_Raw := rEstimatedPropellantMass_Fused;
    END_IF;

    rEstimatedPropellantMass_Acoustic := rAcousticMassEstimate_Raw;
ELSE
    rEstimatedPropellantMass_Acoustic := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* === 6.2: High-Speed Coriolis Flow Integration === *)
(* Continuous trapezoidal integration: Mass = Sum( m_dot * dt ) *)
IF iState >= 80 (* From slow fill onwards *) THEN
    rTotalIntegratedMassFlow := rTotalIntegratedMassFlow + (rVoted_MassFlow * rDeltaTime_Seconds);
END_IF;
rEstimatedPropellantMass_Integrated := rTotalIntegratedMassFlow;

(* === 6.3: Complementary Sensor Fusion (Kalman / Alpha-Beta Blending) === *)
(* Blends high-frequency Coriolis dynamic tracking with zero-drift low-frequency acoustic telemetry *)
IF bAcousticTelemetryEnable AND (rVoted_AcousticPeakFreq > 12.0) THEN
    rEstimatedPropellantMass_Fused := rEstimatedPropellantMass_Fused + (rVoted_MassFlow * rDeltaTime_Seconds) +
                                      rAcousticKalmanGain_K * (rEstimatedPropellantMass_Acoustic - (rEstimatedPropellantMass_Fused + (rVoted_MassFlow * rDeltaTime_Seconds)));
ELSE
    rEstimatedPropellantMass_Fused := rEstimatedPropellantMass_Integrated;
END_IF;

IF rEstimatedPropellantMass_Fused < 0.0 THEN
    rEstimatedPropellantMass_Fused := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* SUB-SECTION 7.0: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) ULLAGE PRESSURE & VENT REGULATION                *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Quadratic Programming (QP) solver loop calculates optimal valve control increments Delta_u.     *)
(*   Minimize: 0.5 * Delta_u^T * H * Delta_u + g^T * Delta_u                                       *)
(*   Subject to: u_min <= u + Delta_u <= u_max, Delta_u_min <= Delta_u <= Delta_u_max              *)
(* Implemented via a 10-iteration Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) projected gradient descent algorithm.    *)

(* Error state vector: e = [ P_ullage_err, dP/dt_err, MassFlow_err ]^T *)
aMPC_State_Error[1] := rVoted_UllagePressure - rSetpoint_TankUllagePressure;
aMPC_State_Error[2] := (rVoted_UllagePressure - rSetpoint_TankUllagePressure) * 1.5; (* Dynamic damping *)
aMPC_State_Error[3] := (rVoted_MassFlow - 28.5) * 0.05; (* Bulk flow deviation *)

(* Linear gradient vector: g = Q * e *)
aMPC_Gradient[1] := aMPC_Weight_Q[1] * aMPC_State_Error[1];
aMPC_Gradient[2] := aMPC_Weight_Q[2] * aMPC_State_Error[2];
aMPC_Gradient[3] := aMPC_Weight_Q[3] * aMPC_State_Error[3];

(* Initialize projected gradient search vector *)
aMPC_Iterative_U[1] := 0.0;
aMPC_Iterative_U[2] := 0.0;
aMPC_Iterative_U[3] := 0.0;

(* --- Projected Gradient Descent Optimization Loop (Unrolled 4 Iterations for Determinism) --- *)
(* Iteration 1 *)
aMPC_Iterative_U[1] := aMPC_Iterative_U[1] - 0.08 * (aMPC_Hessian[1,1]*aMPC_Iterative_U[1] + aMPC_Hessian[1,2]*aMPC_Iterative_U[2] + aMPC_Hessian[1,3]*aMPC_Iterative_U[3] + aMPC_Gradient[1]);
aMPC_Iterative_U[2] := aMPC_Iterative_U[2] - 0.08 * (aMPC_Hessian[2,1]*aMPC_Iterative_U[1] + aMPC_Hessian[2,2]*aMPC_Iterative_U[2] + aMPC_Hessian[2,3]*aMPC_Iterative_U[3] + aMPC_Gradient[2]);
aMPC_Iterative_U[3] := aMPC_Iterative_U[3] - 0.08 * (aMPC_Hessian[3,1]*aMPC_Iterative_U[1] + aMPC_Hessian[3,2]*aMPC_Iterative_U[2] + aMPC_Hessian[3,3]*aMPC_Iterative_U[3] + aMPC_Gradient[3]);
IF aMPC_Iterative_U[1] > 5.0 THEN aMPC_Iterative_U[1] := 5.0; ELSIF aMPC_Iterative_U[1] < -5.0 THEN aMPC_Iterative_U[1] := -5.0; END_IF;
IF aMPC_Iterative_U[2] > 3.0 THEN aMPC_Iterative_U[2] := 3.0; ELSIF aMPC_Iterative_U[2] < -3.0 THEN aMPC_Iterative_U[2] := -3.0; END_IF;
